title: Spectral property for the 2D Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation
summary: We discuss a spectral property for the virial operator of the 2D Zakharov-Kuznetsov (ZK) equation. This is a crucial ingredient to establish blow-up or asymptotic stability of solitary waves in higher-dimensional problems. This model in 3D setting was originally introduced by Zakharov and Kuznetsov in plasma physics, and is also a higher-dimensional generalization of the well-known Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation.
